canonicalStep.title: oil-drain-plug-loosen (BMW 328i draft Engine Oil & Filter Change guide; evidence step 5)

elements.describe: The engine oil drain plug seen end-on, a short external hex head with a copper-coloured crush washer, with the socket fitted over its head.
A plain chrome 17 mm socket fitted over the plug head, on a plain ratchet whose handle extends away from the plug; no markings or engraving.
The oil pan surface around the plug, drawn as a plain simplified matte aluminium-grey surface.
Oil pan perimeter screws, casting ribs and nearby bolts.

This car is an automatic (S205), so plug position and orientation on ITS pan are not established; keep the pan a plain generic mass.
